NewsArticle.Title: Sgrios Summoning
NewsArticle.Content:
Sgrios, the God of Destruction has nearly become disturbed from his half-slumber by rampant summonings.
Faith requirements for summonings increased eightfold. Only the most devout of Sgrios now summon a powerful succubus. Others only summon a much weaker form of succubus. Finally, when a dubhaimid is summoned, such as a succubus, the summoner is stricken by bais earraidh for 20 minutes, which means that Aislings can attack and kill the summoner.
Mileth is the only known mundane region, which means no magic works there, including succubus summonings. At Aisling request, all other villages lost their mundanity a few Deoch ago.
